title: Salty Lady Sportfishing

services.name: Fishing License
services.desc: Due to current regulations we cannot sell fishing licenses on board. They can be purchased at your local sporting goods store or online at the Ca Dept of Fish and Wildlife

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Captain Jared Davis offers a lifetime of fishing experience - and a large, fast, comfortable 56’ boat to fish from. There may be big fish, there may be many fish.

quotes.text: Great day! I would recommend them to anyone wanting to go out the bay and get their fish on!
